title: Book Three · Chapter 96: The Last Two Books
story:
On Friday afternoon, Ronan carries the large paper to the gate.

He does not open the table today. He shows the words to people who stop at Mr Qiu's stall and tells them about tomorrow.

Some ask about the stories. One woman wants books about animals. Another asks for puzzles with clear pictures.

Ronan tells them to come between nine and eleven. He wants them to look at his books, not walk past again.

Leo comes back from his grandmother's after tea. He finds Ronan still beside the gate.

“The six books?” he asks.

“Inside.”

“Checked?”

Ronan looks toward the room. “I started.”

They take the pile to the table. The two travel books are on top of the four stories.

Leo opens one at the back. The cover is firm. Ronan takes the first story and follows the page numbers.

At dinner time, two stories are fully checked. After dinner, Ronan finishes another story and one travel book.

Four books are ready. Two still need a full check.

The last story has a bright cover. The last travel book has a wide blue sea on its first page.

Ronan opens both near the front. The print looks clear. He needs more time to check the rest.

Mum comes for her work basket. She has finished her own last piece for the day.

“Your visit tomorrow,” she says. “Have you got the time?”

“Nine at the library.”

“And your things?”

He puts his bottle and personal money beside his bag. Anna's sheet goes inside it.

Leo checks the fifteen other books for the table. He puts the games book beside the two puzzle books. The garden book stays near the railway stories.

“Ready for the morning,” he says.

Ronan looks at the last two books from Mr Wei's six. He can finish them before breakfast. He puts them on top as a reminder.

“I'll do these first,” he says.

Leo closes one cloth bag. “I'll come early. I'll set out the other row.”

The boys carry the bags to a dry place. Nothing has been sold or paid for today. The cash stays at twenty-five, and all twenty-one books are still there.

After Leo leaves, Ronan sits beside the new large card. Used Books. Two Yuan Each.

He imagines people standing close enough to ask about more than one book. He touches the blue cord at his wrist, then puts his hand down.

Tomorrow he will need to watch two different times. He sets the six books apart from the other fifteen and goes to bed.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

print＝印刷文字；firm＝牢固的；reminder＝提醒物；fully checked＝完整检查过。

## 理解问题

1. Mr Wei六本书里，睡前真正完整检查了几本？哪两本还没检查完？
2. Ronan这天下午主要把时间花在哪里？他打算什么时候补做检查？

## 读句子

**Four books are ready.**

拆开看：Four books / are / ready.

四本书／已经／准备好了。
